\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 229-232 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:LA-R237-first-pass-words-from-chapters-229-232}



\begin{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item to decree, to try, to go on, to hold off, to remove
  \item to wake up, to accompany, to add, to announce, to appear
  \item to turn, to enjoy, to shape, to complain, to be missing
  \item to steal, to uncover, to seem, to serve, to suffer
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
To decree? (\textbf{dēcernō, dēcernere}.) To try? (\textbf{temptō, temptāre}.) To go on? (\textbf{pergō, pergere}.) To hold off? (\textbf{cessō, cessāre}.) To remove? (\textbf{removeō, removēre}.) To wake up? (\textbf{expergīscor, expergīscī}.) To accompany? (\textbf{comitor, comitārī}.) To add? (\textbf{addō, addere}.) To announce? (\textbf{nūntiō, nūntiāre}.) To appear? (\textbf{appāreō, appārēre}.) To turn? (\textbf{vertō, vertere}.) To enjoy? (\textbf{fruor, fruī}.) To shape? (\textbf{fingō, fingere}.) To complain? (\textbf{queror, querī}.) To be missing? (\textbf{dēsum, deesse}.) To steal? (\textbf{fūror, fūrārī}.) To uncover? (\textbf{dētegō, dētegere}.) To seem? (\textbf{videor, vidērī}.) To serve? (\textbf{serviō, servīre}.) To suffer? (\textbf{patior, patī}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
